ui_bugs.issue: 'Ananta Status: 4 paper trading strategies are currently live and monitoring the markets.' toast NEVER appears on fresh session. Root cause: React.StrictMode (enabled in /app/frontend/src/index.js:8) double-invokes useEffect in dev. In /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx:43-56, the effect calls sessionStorage.setItem('ananta_status_toast_seen','1') SYNCHRONOUSLY before scheduling the 600ms setTimeout. Sequence: mount#1 sees no flag → sets flag='1' → schedules toast → cleanup clears timeout; mount#2 sees flag='1' → early return. Net: flag is stamped, timer is cancelled, toast never fires. Fix: move the setItem INSIDE the setTimeout callback (right before/after the toast() call) so that only actually-fired toasts get 'seen'. Or add a module-level ref/guard.

action_items: HIGH: fix Dashboard status toast to actually render. In /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx around L43-56, move the sessionStorage.setItem('ananta_status_toast_seen','1') from before the setTimeout to INSIDE the timeout callback (right where toast() is invoked). This guarantees the flag is only stamped after the toast has truly been dispatched, making the effect resilient to React.StrictMode's double-invoke and any other unmount-before-timer edge cases.

OPTIONAL: also consider adding a top-level useRef guard (e.g. const firedRef = useRef(false); if (firedRef.current) return; firedRef.current = true;) as belt-and-braces against future re-renders re-triggering.
OPTIONAL a11y (carry-over from iter46): add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to WaitlistModal in AccessGateContext.jsx — still emits Radix console warning on open.

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx L43-56: flag-first / effect-async pattern is fragile under React.StrictMode. Rule of thumb: only mark 'seen' AFTER the user-visible side-effect has occurred (i.e., inside the setTimeout callback, right next to the toast() call).

LaunchPage.jsx: h-screen + overflow-hidden strategy works, but note that on very short viewports (<720px) the feature-card stack + hero may overflow. Consider adding a min-height guard or making feature cards flex-shrink. Not blocking.

SignUp.jsx L23: uses simple !name.trim()/!email.trim() checks — no email format validation client-side. Backend enforces format (400), UX would be slightly better with a client-side hint before hitting the API. Minor.

SignUp.jsx L29-32: on API error the button re-enables (setBusy(false)) but on success setBusy is NEVER reset before navigate — fine because the page unmounts; but if a race causes navigation to fail, the button stays disabled. Acceptable given navigate is synchronous.

rca of the issue: Dashboard status toast never renders. File: /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx L43-56. React.StrictMode is enabled at /app/frontend/src/index.js:8 which causes useEffect to run twice in dev. Current sequence: run1 → sessionStorage.setItem('ananta_status_toast_seen','1') runs synchronously → setTimeout scheduled → cleanup clears timeout. run2 → sessionStorage.getItem returns '1' → early return, no toast scheduled. Net: no toast is ever visible; the flag remains stamped so subsequent legitimate loads also skip. Reproduction: (1) open / with a fresh sessionStorage (e.g., sessionStorage.clear()); (2) navigate/reload; (3) observe that no toast appears within 5s and sessionStorage.ananta_status_toast_seen === '1'. Fix: move sessionStorage.setItem inside the setTimeout body, colocated with toast(...) so the seen flag is only ever set as a consequence of the toast actually being dispatched. Optionally guard with a useRef against re-entry within the same mount lifetime.
